# usmile

> > usmile offers AI-powered electric toothbrushes, water flossers, and oral care accessories designed for deep cleaning, whitening, and smart dental hygiene.

usmile specializes in innovative oral care products featuring smart technology like AI-guided brushing, missed spots detection, and precision water flossing. The product lineup ranges from beginner-friendly options to advanced smart toothbrushes, complemented by portable water flossers and replacement accessories for comprehensive dental health.

## Key Topics

- Electric toothbrushes
- Water flossers
- AI-guided brushing
- Smart toothbrush technology
- Plaque removal
- Oral hygiene
- Portable/travel devices
- IPX7 waterproof
- USB-C charging
- Kids toothbrushes
- Replacement brush heads
- Water flosser nozzles
- Precision Pulse technology
- Product bundles
- Dental accessories
